items.title: Drug developers eye sport’s biggest stage as World Cup fever builds
items.summary: Sanofi and Amgen have signed collaborations with US host cities, while TV pharma commercials re-enter the spotlight.

items.title: XtalPi enters $400m partnership for small molecule therapy for GPCR target
items.summary: XtalPi has entered a strategic partnership with a biopharmaceutical company to develop oral small-molecule therapeutics targeting a GPCR.

items.title: Beren pockets $300m to take Niemann-Pick disease therapy to market
items.summary: If approved, Beren's adrabetadex would join Zevra Therapeutics’ Miplyffa and IntraBio’s Aqneursa on the I-NPC market.

items.title: EMA validates Bayer’s asundexian application for ischaemic stroke
items.summary: The EMA has validated Bayer's marketing authorisation application for asundexian, an oral Factor XIa inhibitor, to prevent ischaemic stroke.

items.title: Parabilis Medicines sets biotech record with $670m IPO
items.summary: Parabilis’ US listing means the biotech IPO record has been broken twice in as many months as public listings continue hot streak.
